method: manual semantic review against inspected authoritative/issuer/government sources; search snippets not used as sole evidence

evidence.title: 台船公司刊物：歡迎來到台船大家庭
evidence.note: Issuer publication explicitly describes 台船 as 台灣最大的國際性造船廠.

items.rationale: Official issuer publication directly supports the ranking assertion.

evidence.title: 台船環海：2024 中能風場安裝完成新聞稿
evidence.note: Official CDWE release describes Green Jade as 本國籍最大、亞洲第二大風電工程船.

evidence.title: 台船環海：環海翡翠輪交船典禮
evidence.note: Official release describes the vessel as 台灣第一艘、目前唯一、全球第二大型的風電浮吊船.

items.rationale: The report says 亞洲最大; current official issuer material says 亞洲第二大. Material ranking conflict.
items.proposed_text: 擁有本國籍最大、亞洲第二大風電工程船「環海翡翠輪」

evidence.title: 台船年報
evidence.note: Annual report states steel plate purchasing is concentrated at 中鋼 and calls 中鋼 the long-term ship-steel-plate supplier.

items.rationale: Formal issuer annual report directly identifies 中鋼 as the concentrated/primary ship steel plate supplier.

evidence.title: 漢翔 F-16 戰鬥機業務頁
evidence.note: AIDC documents its F-16 maintenance center role and Lockheed Martin certifications.

evidence.title: 漢翔鳳展專案新聞
evidence.note: AIDC states it is Lockheed Martin's 唯一海外授權與技術轉移的後勤維修中心.

items.rationale: Issuer evidence is stronger than the Asia-Pacific-only formulation: it states unique overseas Lockheed-authorized/technology-transfer logistics maintenance center status.

evidence.title: 漢翔 A-Team 4.0 原物料商聯盟
evidence.note: AIDC confirms 燁鋒 as an A-Team 4.0 aerospace raw-material alliance member and later procurement counterparty, but does not support 亞洲唯一.

items.rationale: Authoritative evidence supports aerospace-aluminum supplier status, not the objective '亞洲唯一' ranking.
items.proposed_text: 燁鋒輕合金 — A-Team 4.0 航太原物料聯盟之鋁合金供應商

evidence.title: 高雄市政府刊物：中信造船
evidence.note: Kaohsiung City Government publication calls 中信造船 台灣最大民營造船廠.

evidence.title: 中信造船產業簡報
evidence.note: Company presentation labels the group 全台灣最大民營造船廠.

items.rationale: Government and issuer materials independently support the ranking.

evidence.title: 中信造船廠房介紹
evidence.note: Official company page states 高鼎遊艇 is 台灣唯一且全亞洲最大鋼鋁遊艇專門製造公司.

items.rationale: Official issuer page directly supports the assertion.

evidence.title: MoneyDJ 中信造船公司資料
evidence.note: Secondary company profile sourced from company briefing lists 中鋼 among steel/aluminum plate raw-material suppliers, but does not establish that it is a 主要供應商.

items.rationale: Supplier relationship is supported, but the materiality qualifier '主要' is not established by inspected authoritative evidence.
items.proposed_text: 中鋼 — 造船用鋼板供應商
